notes: §1985:IX.4.9.2 prints WRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ] [ INVALID KEY imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT INVALID KEY imperative-statement-2 ] [ END-WRITE ]. writeStatement parses the superset, SequentialIoBinder.BindWrite routes an indexed file to KeyedIoBinder.BindWrite (which refuses ADVANCING and END-OF-PAGE on it), and at --std 85 VersionConformancePass refuses the later additions: FROM a literal or figurative constant (COBOL0871), RETRY and WITH NO LOCK (COBOL0900), FILE file-name (DeclinedFilePhrase, COBOL1706), and NOT INVALID KEY before INVALID KEY (VisitConditionalPhrases through ConditionalPhraseAssociation.OutOfPrintedOrder, COBOL0900, the landed fix of kb/Work PB5158), the one arm the prior read found missing. Probed at --std 85: (a) an OCCURS DEPENDING ON record under RECORD VARYING written from a group at two lengths read back whole, and FROM TE (3) (1:10) at its bounds wrote K004XXXXXX; (b) the reversed order, the word RECORD, INVALID KEY twice, FROM after the phrases, FROM the record itself (SR1, COBOL6827) are refused; (c) FROM literal, FROM ZEROS, WITH NO LOCK, RETRY FOREVER, FILE IFILE, AFTER ADVANCING and AT END-OF-PAGE are refused; (d) FROM a group and a subscripted item (duplicate: INV 22); (e) RANDOM, DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access: a duplicate gives INV 22, an out-of-order key in sequential access gives INV 21, a WRITE to a file open INPUT gives status 48 with neither phrase run, and NOT INVALID KEY alone with a USE procedure prints USE 22. The witness runs WRITE FROM with both phrases in order, a new key and a duplicate. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5158 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-06.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-06-refute.json).

next.reason: 1985: "WRITE record-name-1 [FROM identifier-1] [INVALID KEY imperative-statement-1] [NOT INVALID KEY ...]"; 2023: "WRITE {record-name-1|FILE file-name-1} [FROM {identifier-1|literal-1}] [retry-phrase] [WITH LOCK|WITH NO LOCK]". 2023 Format 2 (indexed/relative) adds the FILE phrase, a FROM literal, RETRY and LOCK phrases. Choice indicators let INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY appear in either order.
